caption: exp174 summary. (a) Plan F matches the format's one-document ceiling on lDDT while reaching only a third of it on TM-score — a local metric rewards a well-refined wrong fold. (b) Median CA-RMSD splits cleanly: ~4 Å whenever the coarse boxes are correct, ~16.5 Å whenever they come from the model, regardless of inference spend. (c) The one-document ceiling collapses with chain length because the 8192-token budget is fixed; Plan F re-prompts and runs above it.
